chapter_seo_title: Han Li Establishes a Bizarre Rule at Divine Hand Valley — Chapter 66
chapter_meta_description: Han Li becomes the sect's most respected physician, establishing a bell-ringing rule that even the leaders follow. But a hidden yin-cold energy from Doctor Mo lingers, marking a countdown he cannot escape.
